Thanks for the ping — I will own the IRP and SIG mapping. Marcus, can you pull the incident log and any relevant timeline entries from the 2026-08-29 event (placeholder ticket SEC-842) so we can attach a sanitized CSV?

Summary (doing a short deliverable list here):
- IRP: attached IRP_v2.1.pdf (redacted for public sharing). Key sections preserved: detection & alerting, incident classification, roles & responsibilities, communications matrix, post-incident review process.
- Incident timeline: attached incident_log_2026-08-29.csv (sanitized timestamps and impacted routes). Brief executive summary below (we will expand to one page):

  Executive summary: On 2026-08-29 03:22 UTC Redwood observed increased 5xx error rate on our inference gateway caused by a faulty autoscaling decision after a degraded spot instance pool. Impact: degraded generation latency for ~18 minutes for a subset of small-volume customers. Root cause: race condition in the autoscaler combined with delayed health checks on one instance class. Mitigation: scale-up to reserve capacity, rollback the autoscaler policy, and patch health-check logic. No customer data was exfiltrated; logs and traces indicate no unauthorized access.

  Notification: internal ops was alerted at 03:24 UTC; the incident was declared at 03:26 UTC; customer-impacting mitigation completed by 03:40 UTC; public status update posted at 03:48 UTC.

- SIG workbook: I will populate the IR/Monitoring/Availability tabs and include a mapping note.
- SOC 2 vs SIG: SOC 2 attestation covers the majority of controls, but ZenHealth's questionnaire requests mapping to SIG/CAIQ for cloud-specific questions. We will include a one-page mapping doc (SOC2_to_SIG_mapping_zenhealth.docx) — I'll place it in the shared drive link and provide to Elena.

Next steps: Marcus to drop incident_log and any additional timestamps to the Drive (https://drive.redwood.com/zenhealth/security/2026/IRP). I will attach the redacted IRP and incident log to this thread for ZenHealth. If ZenHealth requests a live walkthrough, I can schedule a 30-min meeting; Elena/Jake please let me know preferred times.

Attachments: IRP_v2.1.pdf; incident_log_2026-08-29.csv
